A complete breakdown 👇

1/ Step 1: Technical Schema

Foundation.

Essential:
• MedicalOrganization
• Physician
• MedicalProcedure
• FAQPage
• Review schema

No schema = AI can't find you.

2/ Step 2: Content Authority

AI prefers expert content.

Write for AI readability:
• Clear headings
• Bullet points
• Concise paragraphs
• Citations
• Updated dates

Don't write for keywords. Write for answers.

3/ Step 3: Entity Building

Entities = real things AI understands.

Build your entity:
• Wikipedia
• Google Business
• Directories
• News mentions

More signals = more trust = more citations.

4/ Step 4: Review Optimization

AI reads individual reviews.

Want:
• Detailed experiences
• Specific outcomes
• Before/after
• Verified reviews

Train staff to ask for detailed feedback.

5/ Step 5: Continuous Monitoring

GEO isn't 'set and forget.'

Track:
• Citation frequency
• Platform mentions
• Competitor citations
• Schema errors

Tools: Search Console, Bing Webmaster.

6/ The results:

Clients implementing this:
• 3.2x more AI citations
• 47% less ad dependency
• 89% more consultations
• $2M+ revenue recovered

This isn't theory. It works.
